## JPMorgan Chase unveils $50 billion buyback, Goldman Sachs raises dividend after Fed stress test

According to the supplied CNBC Business signal, JPMorgan Chase announced a $50 billion share buyback and Goldman Sachs raised its dividend after the Federal Reserve’s annual stress test found that all 32 large banks tested could withstand a hypothetical recession.

For highly regulated financial institutions, regulatory credibility can become a business asset. Passing stress tests does not just satisfy compliance requirements; it can unlock strategic capital actions such as buybacks and dividend increases that reinforce market confidence.
